about: A default_subcommand is marked (default) in the parent command list. default_subcommand_help appends that child's own help page after the parent. A hidden default is neither marked nor appended.

vectors.doc: The default child's command-list row ends with (default) even without the help opt-in.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example"
default_subcommand "install"
cmd "install" help="Put a package on the system" {
    flag "-u --update" help="Update installed packages"
    arg "[package]" help="What to install"
}
cmd "query" help="Look something up"

short_help: install  Put a package on the system (default)
help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

vectors.doc: default_subcommand_help concatenates the child's --help after the parent page.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example"
default_subcommand "install"
default_subcommand_help #true
cmd "install" help="Put a package on the system" {
    flag "-u --update" help="Update installed packages"
    arg "[package]" help="What to install"
}
cmd "query" help="Look something up"

short_help: install  Put a package on the system (default)
help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
Put a package on the system

vectors.doc: A hidden default is omitted from the command list and is not appended.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example"
default_subcommand "install"
default_subcommand_help #true
cmd "install" hide=#true help="Put a package on the system" {
    flag "-u --update"
}
cmd "query" help="Look something up"

short_help: help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
